label: sr_hotel_primitives
title: Operating summaries supplied to the heterogeneous-hotel programs

cells: Remaining fraction of the episode, centered around zero.
Bounded log ratio of total remaining inventory to estimated future effective demand. Negative values retain a meaning: less inventory relative to demand.
Average of a sigmoid transformation of hotel-level demand-to-stock pressure.
Bounded mean future holding-value proxy, scaled by the mean positive candidate price.
Smooth maximum of current customer–hotel match, adjusted for the number of available hotels.
Bounded coefficient of variation of match-adjusted current values.
Higher when available hotels have similar standardized price, star, review, and location attributes.
Average of hotel-support and destination-support summaries.
Bounded log ratio of predicted future effective demand to current hotel inventory.
Centered combination of price affordability, star fit, and hotel-quality indicators.
Bounded difference between current match-adjusted value and the scaled future holding-value proxy.
Bounded logarithmic transformation of training support for that destination–hotel pair.
